matrixTitle: Kshetra Mobile Application Financial Consumer Compatibility Matrix

consumers.currentBehavior: CandidateAffidavit interface enforces non-nullable number for all 4 asset components, totalAssets, and totalLiabilities. formatINR() lacks null check and falls through to null.toLocaleString('en-IN') which throws TypeError. computeWealthGrowth() performs arithmetic on null resulting in NaN. detectRedFlags() treats coerced null liabilities as genuine zero, flagging false-positive 'ZERO_LIABILITIES' anomalies.
consumers.requiredHandling: Change interface fields to 'number | null'. In formatINR(), guard with 'if (amount === null || amount === undefined) return "Not Disclosed";'. In computeWealthGrowth(), return status 'UNKNOWN' if either newer or older totalAssets is null. In detectRedFlags(), only flag zero liability anomaly if totalLiabilities === 0 and NOT null.

consumers.currentBehavior: Calls formatINR(affidavit.totalAssets) and formatINR(affidavit.totalLiabilities) directly. If totalAssets is null, unhandled TypeError crashes component rendering.
consumers.requiredHandling: Display 'Not Disclosed' badge when totalAssets or totalLiabilities is null; protect against calling unhardened formatINR.

consumers.currentBehavior: Local formatINR helper executes amount.toLocaleString('en-IN'). Line 121 guards with 'profile.totalAssets !== undefined'. Because 'null !== undefined' evaluates to true in JavaScript, null is passed to formatINR, throwing 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading toLocaleString)'. Crashes the MLA list screen.
consumers.requiredHandling: Change guard to 'profile.totalAssets != null' (or strict 'profile.totalAssets !== undefined && profile.totalAssets !== null'). Harden local formatINR to return 'Not Disclosed' on null/undefined.

consumers.currentBehavior: Identical vulnerability to MLACard: Line 112 guards with 'profile.totalAssets !== undefined'. Evaluates true for null, calling val.toLocaleString('en-IN') on null. Throws unhandled TypeError and crashes MP directory screen.
consumers.requiredHandling: Change guard to 'profile.totalAssets != null' and guard local formatINR function.

consumers.currentBehavior: Lines 48 & 59-63 use '|| 0' fallback (const totalAssets = latest.totalAssets || 0; const selfMovable = latest.selfMovableAssets || 0; ...). Coerces undisclosed assets to zero, misrepresenting missing disclosures as poverty/zero wealth. Line 54 calculates growth without guarding against null/0 in previous.totalAssets, resulting in Infinity or NaN.
consumers.requiredHandling: Do not coerce null to 0. Render an 'Undisclosed Financial Data' notice if totalAssets is null. Omit asset component breakdown when component disclosures are unverified/null. Handle growth calculation with null-safety.

consumers.currentBehavior: Computes netWorth as '(_winnerAffidavit.totalAssets || 0) - (_winnerAffidavit.totalLiabilities || 0)'. For an elected representative whose assets were not disclosed, computes net worth as ₹0, creating a false factual representation of net worth.
consumers.requiredHandling: If totalAssets is null, netWorth must evaluate to null and display as 'Not Disclosed'.

consumers.currentBehavior: Line 22 evaluates Math.max(...sorted.map(a => a.totalAssets), 1) which treats null as 0. Line 33 uses 'Math.max(Math.round((a.totalAssets / maxAssets) * MAX_BAR_HEIGHT), 8)'. For null totalAssets, forces a minimum 8px bar, visually displaying null as small positive wealth. Lines 57-58 divide by totalAssets, yielding NaN when null.
consumers.requiredHandling: Filter out or separately style undisclosed years with dashed borders or distinct 'No Disclosure' labels. Do not render a minimum height bar for null values.

consumers.currentBehavior: Line 917 sums totalAssets with '|| 0' and divides by total constituency affidavits length, including undisclosed candidates in the denominator and depressing the average. Line 942 includes undisclosed records in the crorepati percentage denominator.
consumers.requiredHandling: Exclude undisclosed (null) records from both numerator and denominator when computing average assets, or display statistics with explicit sample size N_disclosed.
